answer: Bind each voting seat to a licensed harbour pilot. A port authority issues the licence only after years as a deck officer, an exam on local charts, and supervised trips guiding ships to the jetty in fog and gale. Each licence names one person, and the pilots' association audits every job log. Training and dues run about $40,000 per pilot, so 500 sybil seats would cost an attacker roughly $20M, and no grove of fake accounts can steer a real tanker.
